author: Santiago Pedro
text: Very nice guys they done an amazing job and u can tell they really care about there customers

author: Kevin Karem
text: Called them to have a look at a tank i've used for years with no service.  They responded within two days, checked the tank, cleaned it and gave me a report.  Excellent, no non sense and quality service with great expertise.  Will keep working with them!

author: Tracy Alday
text: Jeff & Greg are awesome. I have limited experience in this field and discussed over the phone the issues with the tank. They saved me a LOT of money by being HONEST, which is very limited in today's world.  Instead of telling me I had to have new lines run (which makes a lot of money), they re-routed from the header. Exceptional honest people!! I'd recommend ROSSER'S to anyone!! Saved the number in my phone just in case I need to give it away with stellar recommendations.

author: Mary Neely
text: My family has done business with this company for years, and have been very satisfied. When it was suggested we also use them they were quick and we thought efficient. We chose to have a 1000 gallon holding tank installed and while it was being installed it filled up and they charged us to pump it plus the installation. Then through one summer have had to pump it out 3 times and it’s me and my husband weekends only. After calling unsuccessfully over and over. Asking my family member that “knows them” also call to no avail. Had to hire another service to take over and pump and now repair the tank. Plumbing was never sealed off properly. Very disappointed in the lack of concern  expense and frustration.

author: Jessica Reynolds
text: These guys are great. Fast response time. Great work. Reasonable price. Definitely would recommend them!!!
